prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your new desktop companion a name to finalize adoption.", "Pet Name", "Verified Companion"]
1: ["Pro tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime on your desktop to summon or hide your pet.", "Learn Desktop Shortcuts while your pet renders"]
2: ["Next: Desktop Quick Actions", "Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Right-click your pet on desktop to chat, feed, or minimize to system tray.", "Launch Desktop Pet", "System Tray & Click Controls"]
3: ["Signing in ensures your pet creation and customization are safely saved to your account forever."]
4: ["Photo Rendering Quality Check", "We analyzed your upload. High lighting and clear outlines ensure perfect 3D pet generation.", "Looks Great, Adopt!", "Photo Lighting: Optimal"]
5: ["Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "Select Quick Adopt for instant desktop companion or Custom Studio for full photo crafting.", "Quick Instant Adopt (1 min)", "Custom Photo Studio (3 mins)"]
6: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Companion", "In less than 3 minutes, your interactive virtual pet will live and play right on your desktop screen."]
7: ["If your pet hides, click the Pet icon in your system tray (bottom right corner) to bring it back instantly!"]
8: ["Crafting Your Desktop Companion", "Setting up 3D desktop animations, interactive behaviors, and physics sound effects."]
9: ["For best results, upload well-lit photos facing forward with clear background contrast."]
